workouts.title: Intermediate 20K HM Pace Practice Long Run
workouts.summary: A metric half-marathon support long run with 15K easy and a controlled 5K half-marathon effort finish.
workouts.riskReason: Fast finish quality running at target race pace on pre-fatigued legs.

intensityGuide.primaryTarget: steady progressing to half marathon race pace
intensityGuide.paceGuide: Run first 9 miles conversational, then immediately lock into HM race pace for final 5 kilometers.
intensityGuide.hrGuide: Low Zone 2, spiking rapidly to High Zone 4 in the final segment.
intensityGuide.rpeGuide: RPE 4-5/10, rising to 7.5/10 for the final block.

mainSet.name: First 15K: Conversational Jog
mainSet.description: Run 15 kilometers continuously at a relaxed conversational pace.

mainSet.name: Final 5K: HM Race Effort Finish
mainSet.description: Immediately progress the final 5 kilometers to controlled half-marathon race effort.

easier.description: Reduce to 16K total with a 4K half-marathon effort finish.

mainSet.name: 12K Easy + 4K HM Finish
mainSet.description: Run 12K easy, then progress the final 4K to controlled half-marathon effort.

harder.description: Increase to 22K total with a 6K half-marathon effort finish.

mainSet.name: 16K Easy + 6K HM Finish
mainSet.description: Run 16K easy, then progress the final 6K to controlled half-marathon effort.

coachingNotes: Practice your race-day fueling and hydration strategy every 30-45 minutes.
Start conversational. Do not push the early pace.
Focus on locked-in pacing in the final 5 kilometers.
commonMistakes: Running the first half too fast and hitting the wall.
safetyNotes: Carry hydration or plan routes with water access.
Listen to joint pain. Stop immediately if sharp joint pain occurs.

shareCard.purposeText: A sustained long run including pace blocks exactly at target Half Marathon effort.

mainSet.description: Run 3 repetitions of 4 kilometers at HM race pace with 4 kilometers easy jog recovery.

easier.description: Reduce running progression to 16 kilometers total, with 2 × 4K HM blocks.

mainSet.name: 2 × HM Pace Blocks
mainSet.description: Run 2 reps of 4 kilometers at HM pace with 4 kilometers easy recovery.

harder.description: Increase distance to 26 kilometers total, with 4 × 4K HM blocks.

mainSet.name: 4 × HM Pace Blocks
mainSet.description: Run 4 reps of 4 kilometers at HM pace with 4 kilometers easy recovery.

coachingNotes: Practice your race-day fueling and hydration strategy every 30-45 minutes.
Start conversational. Do not push the early pace.
Focus on locked-in pacing in the HM pace blocks.
commonMistakes: Running the first HM pace block too fast.
safetyNotes: Carry hydration or plan routes with water access.
Listen to joint pain. Stop immediately if sharp joint pain occurs.
